'''DeepXDE: Physics-Informed & Variational Neural Networks (PINNs / VPINNs)'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''DeepXDE''' is a flagship library for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and Variational PINNs (VPINNs). Rather than relying on spatial grid meshes (like FEM or finite differences), DeepXDE represents physical fields as deep neural networks <math>\phi_\theta(x, t)</math> trained via automatic differentiation to minimize PDE residuals and variational action integrals.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Variational Action Minimization (9.5/10):''' DeepXDE natively supports Variational PINNs (VPINNs). Instead of evaluating strong-form differential equations, VPINNs directly minimize the weak-form Action Functional:
<math display="block">S[\phi] = \int_\Omega \mathcal{L}(\phi, \partial_\mu \phi) \, d^4x</math>
The loss function is defined directly as the stationarity condition <math>\delta S = 0</math>, establishing a direct computational bridge to Hamilton's Principle.
* '''Mesh-Free High-Dimensional PDEs:''' Capable of solving field dynamics across non-trivial vacuum geometries without requiring complex spatial grid generation.
* '''Inverse Problem Solving:''' Simultaneously solves for unknown physical field parameters or coupling constants while integrating state trajectories.

== Integration with TPM Framework ==
DeepXDE provides the continuous, mesh-free numerical solver engine for validating non-linear vacuum field solutions derived under SVD postulates.
